compositionSummary: A calibrated project composes four layers in tandem: plugins teach Claude the conventions and procedures; blueprints stamp the operational machinery those procedures drive; invariants pin the guarantees that must hold; patterns are the stack idioms the plugins apply. Each branch selects a coherent slice across all four, so the agent knows the conventions, the repo has the machinery, and the guarantees are enforced together.

kindRoles.plugin: How Claude behaves — skills, hooks, and procedures loaded into the agent. Centrally versioned, referenced not copied.
kindRoles.blueprint: What gets stamped into the repo — npm scripts, GitHub Actions, config files that plugins cannot add.
kindRoles.invariant: A guarantee enforced by tests and hooks — a property that must hold no matter what the code does.
kindRoles.pattern: A concrete stack idiom the plugins apply — the building blocks of the chosen stack.

conditions.label: Always
conditions.rationale: The floor every project stands on before any calibration — safe and consistent by default.

conditions.label: runtime = ts-nextjs
conditions.description: App runs on the TypeScript / Next.js stack.
conditions.rationale: Selects the TS conventions, the Next.js behavior + Prisma procedure, the stamped db/CI machinery, and the stack idioms — so the agent knows the stack and the repo has the commands, together.

conditions.label: runtime = python
conditions.description: App runs on the Python stack (small APIs, ML, data).
conditions.rationale: Python conventions plus the FastAPI/uv skeleton, so the service is idiomatic and immediately runnable.

conditions.label: offline required
conditions.rationale: Offline needs three pieces in tandem: the sync engine (plugin), the queue + installable shell (patterns), and the idempotency guarantee (invariant). None works alone.

conditions.label: protected geo
conditions.rationale: Geo data pulls in PostGIS setup, the Prisma-PostGIS pattern, and the coordinate-fuzzing guarantee.

conditions.label: payments
conditions.rationale: Payments pull in the Stripe behavior and the reconciliation guarantee that keeps charges honest.

conditions.label: auth = clerk
conditions.rationale: Adds Clerk role-based access, middleware, and invite flows.

conditions.label: correctness = append-only
conditions.rationale: Turns on the append-only provenance guarantee — history becomes immutable.

conditions.label: sensitivity = protected
conditions.rationale: The top tier adds the coordinate-fuzzing guarantee on top of whatever geo handling is present — which is why that invariant is shared.

conditions.label: topology = monorepo
conditions.rationale: Stamps the workspace root so multiple apps share code and a generated cross-language client.

conditions.label: field-data domain
conditions.description: A field-app profile at high+ sensitivity.
conditions.rationale: The moat bundle: the field-data plugin and its session guarantee — reserved for field apps at high or protected sensitivity.

provisions.description: Universal, language-agnostic standards: security, git workflow, testing discipline, stage detection.
provisions.purpose: The always-on floor every project stands on before any calibration. Everything else layers on top of it.

provisions.description: TypeScript-strict conventions, Zod-at-the-boundary, service-oriented structure.
provisions.purpose: Makes Claude write idiomatic, strict TypeScript with validation at the boundary — applied to every file in a ts-nextjs app.

provisions.description: uv, ruff, pytest, FastAPI layout, Pydantic-at-the-boundary.
provisions.purpose: Makes Claude write idiomatic Python with FastAPI + Pydantic conventions; the FastAPI OpenAPI spec is the cross-language contract.

provisions.description: App Router, RHF + Zod forms, Prisma + db-migrations procedure.
provisions.purpose: Teaches the Next.js conventions and the Prisma migration procedure (never db push in prod, migrations append-only). Pairs with the blueprint that stamps the actual commands.

provisions.description: PostGIS setup and geo queries.
provisions.purpose: Teaches PostGIS setup and geo queries, and carries the coordinate-fuzzing guarantee for protected location data.

provisions.description: Clerk roles, middleware, and invite flows.
provisions.purpose: Wires Clerk authentication: role-based access, route middleware, and invite-only onboarding.

provisions.description: Stripe payment invariants and webhook handlers.
provisions.purpose: Payment handling with reconciliation guarantees and the webhook-verification procedure.

provisions.description: Offline sync engine, Zustand queue, PWA manifest.
provisions.purpose: The offline capability: the sync engine plus the idempotency guarantee that replaying the write queue is always safe.

provisions.description: Domain moat: offline-sync, coordinate-fuzzing, append-only invariants.
provisions.purpose: The domain moat for field apps — the append-only provenance, coordinate fuzzing, and session rules that make protected field data trustworthy.

provisions.description: npm db scripts + CI/deploy workflows with prisma migrate deploy as a release step.
provisions.purpose: Stamps the db commands and CI/deploy machinery that the avani-nextjs migration procedure operates on. The blueprint gives every project identical commands; the plugin makes Claude use them the same way.

provisions.description: pyproject (uv), ruff + pytest config, service skeleton, CI caller.
provisions.purpose: Stamps the uv/ruff/pytest config and FastAPI service skeleton the avani-python conventions assume.

provisions.description: npm-workspaces root, apps/ + packages/shared layout, root CLAUDE.md.
provisions.purpose: Stamps the workspace root and apps/packages layout that lets multiple apps in one project share code and contracts.

provisions.description: Records are never deleted, only superseded with a correction flag.
provisions.purpose: The provenance guarantee: history is immutable, corrections are additive. Enforced by tests + hooks, taught by avani-field-data.

provisions.description: Public-facing exports fuzz coordinates; exact coords are admin-only.
provisions.purpose: Protects sensitive locations. Selected by two branches — any geo data, and the protected sensitivity tier — the shared guarantee.

provisions.description: Every observation carries a globally unique id (offline-sync idempotency).
provisions.purpose: Makes replaying the offline queue idempotent — the property the sync engine depends on to be safe.

provisions.description: Charged amounts reconcile against source-of-truth line items.
provisions.purpose: Guarantees money charged always ties back to authoritative line items — no silent drift.

provisions.description: Field sessions expire 24h after the event they belong to.
provisions.purpose: Bounds stale-credential risk for volunteers in the field by tying session life to the event, not the login.

provisions.description: Next.js App Router routing conventions.
provisions.purpose: The routing idiom avani-nextjs applies across the app.

provisions.description: React Hook Form wired to shared Zod schemas.
provisions.purpose: Forms validate against the same Zod schemas the server uses — one shape, client and server.

provisions.description: Zustand store backing an offline write queue.
provisions.purpose: The client-side write queue the offline sync engine drains when connectivity returns.

provisions.description: PWA manifest + service worker for installable offline use.
provisions.purpose: Makes the app installable and usable with no network — the shell offline sync runs inside.

provisions.description: Prisma with the PostGIS extension for geo columns.
provisions.purpose: The ORM wiring that lets geo queries and coordinate fuzzing work through Prisma.
